title: Welcome Homestead Ranch Rm #4
description:
Private bedroom in 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment situated in a lovely pristine valley. Several hiking trails lead through meadow to Timberlands Park, a lovely pond, and Big East Fork Creek. 

Your room is within a 3 bedroom apt which  is part of a duplex ranch house, separated from a one-bedroom apt by a wall.  The rom is equipted with a pushbutton lock.

The space
Common areas include kitchen and living/dining  room. The full bathroom in common hallway is shared with the two other rooms in the apartment.

Guest access
The ranch house is located at the end of a long dirt driveway opposite the mailbox. 

Text or call the day you arrive to receive the door punch code to the front door and a key to your private bedroom.s

During your stay
High speed fiber-optic cable is available.  We live about 1/4 mile away. We may say hello from time to time to see if everything is going ok, but we prefer that you call us if anything needs correction.

Other things to note
Texting me on my cell phone is the easiest way to reach me. I am usually at my home nearby at Big East Fork Retreat "up the creek"

We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.

We look forward to your stay
